s2.title: One voice, three products
pillars: Read-aloud with natural and personal voices (Aybal) and speech → live effect in under a second (LiveFX).
German, Turkish and English from day one: Aybal with 3 interface and 13 voice languages, LiveFX with automatic DE/TR/EN recognition.
One audience, three entry points: families read (Aybal), creators and teachers stream (LiveFX), children learn with their own stories (book series).
s2.bottom: One investment, one shared voice and content stack, three revenue paths.

cards.status: Platform built · closed beta from 12 Oct 2026 · Germany launch 20 Nov 2026
Version 2.0 working · no revenue yet · Turkish launch Q4 2026
5 books in TR/DE/EN · trailers in 3 languages · teen spin-off in progress

s7.title: Synergies: one stack, one audience
items: Recognition, speech output and word timing power both products: read-aloud with word highlighting (Aybal), scenes and pronunciation (LiveFX).
The book series supplies read-aloud titles for Aybal and story packs for LiveFX story mode.
Both start in the German-Turkish community: Aybal with its Germany launch, LiveFX with Turkish creators.
Read-aloud streams lead families to Aybal; Aybal families are the target group for LiveFX WortBild (language learning).
s7.note: Synergies are hypotheses and not yet measured.
